title: template_graph_replica item: TemplateGraphMeta
description: Per-template replica metadata: last applied templateSeq and staleness (SX-02 fallback GRAPH_STALE). DISENO 'graphStale' boolean is unified into 'state'.
$comment: Table template_graph_replica (per cell): local replica of the version DAG fed by EV-03/EV-04 (ADR-018, DEC-04). Item types: TemplateGraphNode (PK = TPL#<templateId>, SK = V#<templateVersion>) and TemplateGraphMeta (PK = TPL#<templateId>, SK = META). AP-I6: TransactWriteItems(node + META.appliedSeq) with condition appliedSeq = seq - 1. No TTL (graph is permanent; WITHDRAWN is never deleted, DISENO 4.6). No GSI.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency attribute (CLAUDE.md DynamoDB rules; RF-067): every write is conditional on the previous value and increments it.

createdBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id that created the item; system writers use the service-principal uuid configured per service.

updatedBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id of the last write; changes on every write.

updatedAt.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): instant of the last write; changes on every write.

state.description: IN_SYNC -> GRAPH_STALE when a templateSeq gap is not closed or SX-02 is down; GRAPH_STALE -> IN_SYNC after rehydration (DISENO 'graphStale'). Lifecycle and who sets it: DISENO 3.8.2 (DEC-27).
